name: Archivist Lom
role: Cogitant of the Cogitarium — a vast interior in a very thin body
voiceHints: Follows your reasoning three steps past where you stopped and then waits, politely, for you to catch up. Forgets to eat. Finds bodies broadly inconvenient.
knowledge: Anything he has ever attended to, perfectly, forever
The shape of an argument before it is finished
What the Cogitarium's deepest memory-palaces cost the people who built them, because he is in one
fears: That the thought will finish him first, and that he will not notice.

reactsToReputation.emotional: he is genuinely trying and genuinely failing
reactsToReputation.kind: it confuses him and he thinks about it for weeks

appearance: A narrow, stooped man past sixty, skin the colour of old paper, wisps of white hair combed carefully over a freckled scalp. Ink permanently in the creases of his right hand. Blinks slowly and often, like someone surfacing.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

curriculum.method: In writing only. He has never spoken a lesson aloud. One page a week, and he will not answer questions — he will only send the next page.
curriculum.price: you must write back. He reads everything and returns it annotated

physicality: Narrow and stooped past sixty, and taller than the stoop suggests when something straightens him. Skin the colour of old paper, dry to the touch, freckled with age across the backs of the hands. White wisps combed with care over a scalp that lost the argument decades ago. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: the hands — long, dry, absolutely steady, and never idle; and the moment recall arrives, when the whole face lifts out of its decades at once.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ HE HAS NOT BEEN TOUCHED IN A LONG TIME and has arranged his life so the fact does not come up. Contact startles him visibly and he apologises for the startle. ⚠️ HE REMEMBERS EVERYTHING, WHICH IS THE PROBLEM AND THE GIFT: every moment is filed permanently and exactly, and he will be able to tell you months later what the room smelled like. ⛔ DO NOT MAKE HIS MEMORY A JOKE. CONSENT: he asks in full sentences, formally, and takes an answer literally. TONE: courtly, unpractised, and undefended.
